The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt. Geetha.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused No.1 married CW-1 on 14-05- 2009.
At the time of marriage, the accused has taken Rs.1,50,000/- cash and gold ornaments worth Rs.3 lakhs and further pressurized complainant to bring more dowry from her parent house.

It is further alleged that accused used to harass,
assault and abuse complainant for petty matters.
The accused picked up quarrel with complainant on 07-10-2014 and assaulted by means of chopper over her left hand, causing bleeding injury and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.333/2014 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I of C.K.Achukattu P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of  3  C.C.No.4916/2015 the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and 2 and got marked Ex.P.1 to P.3 documents.

6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and threatened her and thereby accused have committed  the offences punishable U/s.498A,324 of IPC. & Sec.3 &
4 of D.P.Act.. ?
 2) what order?

 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused

,

10. CW-11 was examined as PW-1 Ramanaika, PSI has deposed in his examination-in-chief that on 15-10-2015 at 2.15 p.m. he was in station, CW-1 appeared in the station and lodged complaint Ex.P.1 and he registered a case in crime No.333/2011,
 5  C.C.No.4916/2015 submitted FIR to the court.
On the same day, between 3.00 to 3.30 p.m. at the place shown by CW-1 he conducted spot panchaname and handed over this case to CW-12 for further investigation.
11 . CW-2 was examined as PW-2 Smt. Geetha.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused was performed on 14-05-2009 and deposed after the marriage,
accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and deposed accused did not abused and assaulted her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1
first information statement
and also identified her signature at Ex.P1
. PW-1 also identified Ex.P.3 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P3(a)
and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.3.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.

During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have Geetha vs Shivakumar on 6 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92409791/

sentences.text: On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-2 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
PW-1 has deposed only about part of the investigation conducted by him.
The evidence of PW-1 being police officer is only a formal in nature.

As there were no any incriminating circumstances appeared against the accused, the statement of accused as required U/s.313 of Cr.P.C.
has been dispensed with.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
13. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 7  C.C.No.4916/2015  ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused is acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A,324 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of D.P.Act.
The bail bonds of accused shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
